channel.title: Belach Bioteknik blog
channel.description: Articles on bioreactors, scale-up, biosafety and bioprocess control from Belach Bioteknik.

item.title: Bioreactor scale-up: from benchtop to production scale
item.description: Why bioreactor scale-up fails and how to plan it: P/V, kLa, tip speed, mixing time, CO2 and heat removal, plus scale-down models from lab to production.

item.title: Parallel bioreactors and design of experiments: faster bioprocess development
item.description: How parallel bioreactors and design of experiments (DoE) speed up strain screening and bioprocess development, and support QbD and scale-down models.

item.title: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and data integrity for bioreactor control software
item.description: What 21 CFR Part 11 compliance means for bioreactor software: scope, audit trails, e-signatures, ALCOA+, EU Annex 11 and a practical evaluation checklist.
